# Painter Hotline

> Colorado painting company covering the Front Range from one phone number. Interior and exterior house painting, cabinet refinishing, deck and fence staining, residential and commercial work across 47 communities from Longmont to Castle Rock, Fort Morgan to Breckenridge. Over 20 years of experience, fully insured, 5-year workmanship warranty.

## Business facts

- Name: Painter Hotline
- Website: https://painterhotline.com

- Insurance: fully insured, proof of coverage at every quote
- Warranty: 5-year workmanship warranty in writing, plus manufacturer warranty on coatings

- Quotes: free, written, from photos or an on-site walkthrough
- Current offer: 25% off painting projects booked by October 31, 2026; labor only, paint and materials not included
- Related site: https://denverpaintcontractors.com

## Published Colorado cost context

- Exterior house painting: about $1.55 to $4.10 per square foot of paintable surface (2026 published Front Range data)
- Interior painting: about $1.50 to $3.50 per square foot
- Kitchen cabinet refinishing: about $2,000 to $8,000 per kitchen

## Colorado conditions

- UV increases roughly 10% per 1,000 meters of elevation (World Health Organization); Denver sits near 1,600 meters and Breckenridge near 2,900
- Denver average last spring freeze about May 5; average first fall freeze about October 7 (National Weather Service, Boulder)
- Mountain towns have a shorter exterior painting season at both ends
- Homes built before 1978 may contain lead paint; the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting rule applies

## Service area

- Denver metro: Denver, Aurora, Lakewood, Arvada, Westminster, Wheat Ridge, Golden, Commerce City, Northglenn, Thornton
- South metro: Littleton, Centennial, Englewood, Greenwood Village, Highlands Ranch, Lone Tree, Parker, Castle Rock, Castle Pines
- North and Boulder County: Brighton, Broomfield, Louisville, Lafayette, Superior, Erie, Boulder, Longmont, Fort Lupton, Dacono, Firestone, Frederick, Hudson, Lochbuie
- Eastern plains: Bennett, Strasburg, Byers, Fort Morgan, Wiggins
- Foothills and mountains: Evergreen, Conifer, Morrison, Idaho Springs, Georgetown, Silverthorne, Dillon, Frisco, Breckenridge
